name: Headhunter's Spear restores 30% maximum Energy (#4405)
contract: Headhunter's Spear 503405 is a thrown-weapon ability whose tooltip reads 'restores $706816s2% of your maximum Energy'; 706816 (Collecting Heads) carries SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT with MiscValue 3 (Energy) and base points 29, so 30% of maximum Energy. 503405 has no trigger spell and no energy cost (PowerType 3, ManaCost 0) and requires a weapon of subclass 16, the thrown subclass (EquippedItemClass 2, mask 65536), so the Energy has to come from the module: HandleAscensionClassMechanics12To17Hit casts 706816 for every spell in BARBARIAN_HEADHUNTERS_SPEAR 503402-503407, 504712, 804137 on a successful hostile hit (modules/mod-ascension-compat/src/AscensionClassMechanics12To17.cpp). That chain is present in the source; this scenario decides whether it reaches the player at runtime: with 0 Energy and no other Energy source, only the 30% restore can push the caster past 25 within two seconds, since the core regenerates 10 Energy per second (Player::Regenerate).

steps.label: Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Throw the spear at the enemy
The 30% Energy restore lands (regeneration alone reaches 20 in two seconds)
